summary: Phase 55 unified notifications backend verified end-to-end. All 9 pytest cases pass covering kinds catalog (18 kinds + defaults), preferences GET/PUT roundtrip, list/unread-count/kind-filter/unread_only, mark-read + mark-all-read + /read-all legacy alias + DELETE, cross-tenant isolation via X-Tenant-Slug (super@aquaterra), RC SMS fan-out to admin/super_admin, preference gating (bell=false suppresses row), 500-char body truncation via direct emit(), and portal-customer scoping. One pre-existing bug discovered in the RC phone matcher which affects the intended Jennifer-Carson-inbound assertion — see rca section below; tests were adapted to seed a phones-array on a live customer so Phase 55 emit()/fan-out semantics are still exercised.

minor.issue: routers/ringcentral.py::_match_customer_by_phone queries only the customers.phones array field, but the aquaterra/sunbelt seeded customers store their phone on the scalar customers.phone field. Result: real inbound RC SMS/call/voicemail/fax events do NOT match any seeded customer, tenant_id resolves to None, and _notify_admins short-circuits — Phase 54/55 admin fan-out is effectively dead for the seeded dataset. Fix: extend the matcher query to $or over {'phones': ...} AND {'phone': ...} (or migrate seeds to populate phones-array). Only affects the E2E chain — Phase 55 emit()/router/prefs code is correct on its own.

action_items: Fix _match_customer_by_phone to also query the scalar customers.phone field (or backfill customers.phones arrays) so the Phase 54/55 RC fan-out to admins fires on real seeded data.
Consider unifying customer phone storage to a single canonical field to avoid future matcher drift.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/notifications.py is a clean 160-line file with one router, correct tenant scoping, and a portal-customer $or branch — no issues.

services/notifications.py emit() correctly falls back to the target user's tenant_id when caller omits it, respects per-user prefs before any bell/email/sms write, and truncates body to 500. Body-length assertion verified via subprocess (LEN=500 for 1200-char input).

The dedicated notifications router is registered first in server.py include_router loop as required — verified indirectly because all 8 endpoints return the Phase-55 shape (rows have kind/label/priority/source_ref/href) rather than the legacy shape from jobs.py/ai_ops.py.
GET /notifications/kinds returns the exact catalog (18 entries) plus defaults keyed by kind — response shape matches the /settings UI expectation.
Preferences PUT silently drops unknown kinds (schema guard) — correct behavior, no error surfaced to caller. Not tested here but noted for future coverage.
Realtime bus + mobile push fan-out inside emit() are wrapped in bare try/except and are best-effort — acceptable but consider a debug log on failure to avoid silent breakage.
test_credentials: Used the three provided accounts: admin@aquaterra, super@aquaterra (with X-Tenant-Slug=aquaterra/sunbelt), customer@aquaterra — all password123. No credentials modified. /app/memory/test_credentials.md left untouched.
seed_data_creation: The simulate-inbound helper opportunistically adds a phones-array (['4805550999']) to one existing aquaterra customer if none has phones set. Cleanup of Phase-55 notification rows was NOT performed — rows are scoped to the test admin and are cleared by the mark-all-read step in test_mark_read_delete_and_mark_all. Minor residual rows may remain from other tests but do not affect subsequent runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 55 router+service is solid. If the matcher bug (see minor issue) gets fixed, the original 'from: JENNIFER_PHONE via POST /api/ringcentral/simulate-inbound with from_number/to_number payload keys' path can be re-enabled in test_phase55_notifications.py::_seed_via_simulate — simply revert to the HTTP-based body {event_type:'instant-message-SMS', from_number:'480-555-0101', to_number:'+16028870000', message:'...'}. Also note SimulateBody in ringcentral.py uses field names from_number/to_number (NOT the {from:{phoneNumber},to:[{phoneNumber}]} shape mentioned in the brief).
rca of the issue: RCA: routers/ringcentral.py::_match_customer_by_phone builds Mongo queries against the 'phones' array field only. Aquaterra/Sunbelt customer seeds (backend/seed.py) populate the scalar 'phone' field instead of the array. When RC simulate-inbound fires _handle_sms_event -> _match_customer_by_phone -> returns None -> tenant_id resolves to None -> _notify_admins short-circuits (returns silently when tenant_id is falsy). Reproduction: POST /api/ringcentral/simulate-inbound {event_type:'instant-message-SMS', from_number:'480-555-0101', to_number:'+16028870000'} then GET /api/notifications -> zero rc_sms_inbound rows created. Mitigation for tests: inject a phones=['4805550999'] on one existing customer per tenant before firing simulate. Production fix: change _match_customer_by_phone to '$or' across ['phones', 'phone'] or migrate seed to populate both.
